mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish. Clear skies prevail around the Verona Public Library with a temperature of 31 degrees, feeling like 23. You can catch a view of the Waxing Crescent moon tonight, with overnight lows dipping to 30 degrees and no rain expected.

City updates include an upcoming Plan Commission review of Sub-Zero's site plan for Liberty Business Park. In addition, the Municipal Court reminds residents that non-mandatory citations can be paid online or submitted via plea sheets.
There are currently no community events listed on the Verona calendar for the next 30 days.
On Saturday, October 25th, officers responded to a vehicle stopped at an intersection on Plympton Street and arrested a 40-year-old man for an O W I.
Today's flavor of the day at Culver's is Raspberry Cheesecake. The restaurant is open until 10:30 PM tonight, and tomorrow's flavor will be Caramel Cashew.
